ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater / TA450 RMM weaponization — Atera/ScreenConnect/Syncro installer run from phishing link
ucs.description: Hunts MuddyWater's signature initial-access play: spear-phishing PDFs/links pointing to installers of legitimate remote-monitoring-and-management (RMM) tools (Atera, ScreenConnect/ConnectWise, RemoteUtilities, Syncro, SimpleHelp, AnyDesk), then the agent executing shortly after the click — a tradecraft pattern Microsoft (Mango Sandstorm) and Proofpoint (TA450) tie specifically to this Iranian MOIS crew.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("AteraAgent.exe","setup_atera*.exe","ScreenConnect*.exe","connectwisecontrol*.exe","RemoteUtilities*.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","Syncro*.exe","SimpleHelp*.exe","RemoteAccess*.exe","anydesk.exe")) (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("outlook.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","explorer.exe","winrar.exe","7zFM.exe","7zG.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` 
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
let RMM = dynamic(["ateraagent.exe","setup_atera.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","remoteutilities.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","syncro.exe","syncrosetup.exe","simplehelp.exe","remoteaccess.exe","anydesk.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where FileName in~ (RMM)
   or ProcessVersionInfoProductName has_any ("Atera","ScreenConnect","ConnectWise","Remote Utilities","Syncro","SimpleHelp","AnyDesk")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("outlook.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","explorer.exe","winrar.exe","7zfm.exe","7zg.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
let RMM = dynamic(["ateraagent.exe","setup_atera.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","remoteutilities.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","syncro.exe","syncrosetup.exe","simplehelp.exe","remoteaccess.exe","anydesk.exe"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| extend ChildName = tostring(split(ActingProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where ChildName in~ (RMM)
| extend ParentName = tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where ParentName in~ ("outlook.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","explorer.exe","winrar.exe","7zfm.exe","7zg.exe")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ChildName, ActingProcessCommandLine, ParentName, ParentProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater RMM Installer Spawned by Browser or Mail Client
id: 8e1c4a02-7b3d-4f9a-bb21-2f6e9a1c4d33
status: experimental
description: Detects legitimate RMM agents (Atera/ScreenConnect/Syncro/SimpleHelp/AnyDesk) launched by a browser, mail client, or archive tool - MuddyWater/TA450 initial-access tradecraft.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\AteraAgent.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe'
      - '\ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe'
      - '\rutserv.exe'
      - '\rfusclient.exe'
      - '\Syncro.exe'
      - '\SimpleHelp.exe'
      - '\anydesk.exe'
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\winrar.exe'
      - '\7zFM.exe'
      - '\7zG.exe'
  condition: selection_child and selection_parent
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate IT support deployments where the MSP installer is launched from a downloaded archive
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.t1204.001
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\explorer.exe OR *\winrar.exe OR *\7zFM.exe OR *\7zG.exe) @Image:(*\AteraAgent.exe OR *\ateraagent.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe OR *\rutserv.exe OR *\rfusclient.exe OR *\Syncro.exe OR *\SimpleHelp.exe OR *\anydesk.exe OR *\AnyDesk.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/(outlook|chrome|msedge|firefox|explorer|winrar|7zfm|7zg)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/(ateraagent|screenconnect\.clientservice|screenconnect\.windowsclient|connectwisecontrol\.client|rutserv|rfusclient|syncro|simplehelp|anydesk)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=[count(), min(_time), max(_time)])

ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater PowGoop DLL side-load — goopdate.dll loaded outside Program Files driving PowerShell
ucs.description: Hunts MuddyWater's PowGoop loader: a legitimately-signed Google updater binary side-loads a malicious goopdate.dll from a non-standard directory, which decodes config.txt and spawns obfuscated PowerShell. PowGoop is a near-unique MuddyWater/Seedworm/MERCURY artifact reported by CISA and Cisco Talos.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("GoogleUpdate.exe","goopdate.exe")) (Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` 
| where match(process,"(?i)(config\.txt|goopdate|-enc |encodedcommand|frombase64string|downloadstring|iex)") 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` 
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 30d;
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where FileName =~ "goopdate.dll"
| where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files\Google"
     and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)\Google"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, LoaderProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          LoaderPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath, LoaderCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          DllPath = FolderPath, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 30d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\GoogleUpdate.exe" or ParentProcessName endswith "\\goopdate.exe"
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\cmd.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any ("config.txt","goopdate","-enc","EncodedCommand","FromBase64String","DownloadString","IEX")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater PowGoop goopdate.dll Side-Load From Non-Standard Path
id: c4f7a911-2d6b-4e83-9a0c-71b8e3d2f5aa
status: experimental
description: Detects the PowGoop loader where goopdate.dll is image-loaded from a directory other than the legitimate Google install location.
logsource:
  category: image_load
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\goopdate.dll'
  filter_legit:
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
      - 'C:\Program Files\Google\'
      - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Google\'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Portable/relocated legitimate Google Update components (rare)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1574.002
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/(googleupdate|goopdate)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/(cmd|powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(config\\.txt|goopdate|-enc|encodedcommand|frombase64string|downloadstring|iex)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=[count(), min(_time)])
ucs.rationale: The goopdate.dll filename is a legitimate Google component, but MuddyWater's PowGoop abuses it as a side-load host dropped outside the real Google install tree to decrypt config.txt and run PowerShell — a chain CISA AA22-055A and Talos attribute specifically to MuddyWater/Seedworm/MERCURY.
